title: Lockheed Constellation 客機工程史
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以Constellation客機歷史討論增壓、活塞螺槳動力、尾翼與長途任務的整合。各算例使用通用模型，不推斷歷史機型實際性能。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use Constellation history to discuss pressure cabins, piston-propeller propulsion, empennage and long-mission integration using generic models rather than inferred historical performance. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 螺槳推進的能量效率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Propeller energy efficiency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 螺槳推進的能量效率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Propeller energy efficiency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。
steps.instructionEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Lockheed Constellation 客機工程史實際性能或製程：T=500 N，V=30 m/s，Pshaft=20000 W。式 ηp=TV/Pshaft，基準結果 0.75 fraction。適用條件：穩態前進飛行能量比，未含引擎熱效率，不是真機螺槳設定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Lockheed Constellation airliner engineering history: T=500 N, V=30 m/s and shaft power=20000 W. Formula ηp=TV/Pshaft gives 0.75 fraction. Conditions: Steady forward-flight energy ratio, excluding engine thermal efficiency and not defining propeller settings.
steps.failure: 計算η大於1表示單位、時序或能量邊界錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Efficiency above one indicates a unit, timing or energy-boundary error.
steps.check: 同時比較推力、速度與軸功率，排除不同測點的最大值拼接。
steps.checkEn: Compare thrust, speed and shaft power simultaneously rather than joining maxima from different conditions.

knowledge.title: 螺槳推進的能量效率
knowledge.text: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。
knowledge.textEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把Pshaft改成25000 W；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 0.75 改為 0.6 fraction。在算式區重算並記下對「螺槳推進的能量效率」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only shaft power to 25000 W, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 0.75 to 0.6 fraction. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Propeller energy efficiency, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
將不同條件的最大推力與最小功率相除仍可得到效率。
optionsEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Combining maximum thrust and minimum power from different conditions gives valid efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。 同時比較推力、速度與軸功率，排除不同測點的最大值拼接。
quiz.explanationEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed. Compare thrust, speed and shaft power simultaneously rather than joining maxima from different conditions.

steps.title: 引擎軸功率與傳動：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Engine shaft power and transmission: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 引擎軸功率與傳動 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Engine shaft power and transmission and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 機械功率等於扭矩乘角速度；齒輪改變轉速與扭矩，損失使兩端功率不相等。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical power equals torque times angular speed; gearing changes speed and torque, while losses make input and output power unequal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Lockheed Constellation 客機工程史實際性能或製程：P=10000 W，n=1200 rpm。式 T=P/[2πn/60]，基準結果 79.5774715 N·m。適用條件：穩態軸功率、未含扭振或效率，非真機傳動設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Lockheed Constellation airliner engineering history: P=10000 W and n=1200 rpm. Formula T=P/[2πn/60] gives 79.5774715 N·m. Conditions: Steady shaft power without torsional vibration or efficiency; not an operational drivetrain design.
steps.failure: 把rpm直接當rad/s會錯估扭矩；扭矩峰值不能由平均功率完全推出。
steps.failureEn: Treating rpm as rad/s corrupts torque, and average power does not determine peak torque.
steps.check: 確認rpm轉rad/s，將輸入及輸出功率時間對齊以區分暫態儲能。
steps.checkEn: Convert rpm to rad/s and time-align input/output power to distinguish transient energy storage.

Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Engine shaft power and transmission, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
固定功率下轉速越高，扭矩也越高。
機械功率等於扭矩乘角速度；齒輪改變轉速與扭矩，損失使兩端功率不相等。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
At fixed power, higher speed gives higher torque.
Mechanical power equals torque times angular speed; gearing changes speed and torque, while losses make input and output power unequal.
